title: Season 2
summary: The second season of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers was first broadcast in Italy on September 17th, 2011 on Rai Due. It premiered in the UK on April 16th, 2012 on the CITV network. It premiered in the US on Nicktoons on April 21st, 2013. This season follows Lok's quest to decipher the quatrains of Nostradamus and prevent the end of the world, as Sophie uncovers the truth about the Casterwill family as she fights to lead them against a dangerous new enemy, the Blood Spiral.

sections.heading: Production
sections.wikitext:
The American company Viacom became a co-owner of Rainbow S.p.A. ahead of the second season's premiere in 2011. It premiered on September 17, 2011, on Rai 2 in Italy, on April 16, 2012, on CITV in the UK, and April 21, 2013, on Nicktoons in the US. The final episode aired in Italy on December 11, 2011, in the UK on May 30, 2012. Broadcasting in the US ended on June 30, 2013, with Episodes 38 to 52 not being released in the US until the ''Huntik'' aired on Netflix on October 15th, 2015.

The second season saw some changes to the voice cast. [[Matt Caplan]] (credited as Drew Aaron) took over the role of [[Lok Lambert]] from [[Yuri Lowenthal]] while [[Marc Diraison]] took over the role of [[Rassimov]] following the passing of [[Maddie Blaustein]].

sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
With the defeat of the Professor, a new menace has arrived. Rassimov has become stronger, and a new [[The Organization|Organization]] has formed under [[Wilder]]. Having trained since their last battle with [[the Professor]], [[Lok Lambert]], [[Dante Vale]], [[Sophie Casterwill]], and [[Zhalia Moon]] must now face this new menace. To help with their adventures, a new Seeker, [[Den Fears]], is recruited to face off against the [[Blood Spiral|Blood Spiral Brotherhood]]. In addition to this new member, the [[Powerbond]] has been unleashed, transforming the team's [[Titans]] to be stronger than ever before.

Having discovered [[Eathon Lambert|Eathon Lambert's]] Holotome, the [[Huntik Foundation]] begins to investigate the Holotome's riddles concerning the prophecies of the ancient [[Seeker]], [[Nostradamus]]. The truth about the [[Casterwill family]] becomes revealed bit by bit, beginning with the discovery of a legendary sword, the [[Willblade]].

sections.heading: Home Media
sections.wikitext: Unlike the [[Season 1|first season]], Season 2 was not physically released on DVD. In 2015, the series was made available on Netflix where it remained until 2020. In 2020, it was made available on childrens' streaming apps, HappyKids.tv and Kidoodle TV. In 2024, the entire season was made available on the official [[YouTube|Huntik YouTube channel]]. In September 2026, the season began releasing on Amazon Prime as part Rainbow's ''Winx Club & Friends'' channel, beginning with the release of the first two episodes.

The second season of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers was first broadcast in Italy on September 17th, 2011 on Rai Due. It premiered in the UK on April 16th, 2012 on the CITV network. It premiered in the US on Nicktoons on April 21st, 2013. This season follows Lok's quest to decipher the quatrains of Nostradamus and prevent the end of the world, as Sophie uncovers the truth about the Casterwill family as she fights to lead them against a dangerous new enemy, the Blood Spiral.

Production

The American company Viacom became a co-owner of Rainbow S.p.A. ahead of the second season's premiere in 2011. It premiered on September 17, 2011, on Rai 2 in Italy, on April 16, 2012, on CITV in the UK, and April 21, 2013, on Nicktoons in the US. The final episode aired in Italy on December 11, 2011, in the UK on May 30, 2012. Broadcasting in the US ended on June 30, 2013, with Episodes 38 to 52 not being released in the US until the Huntik aired on Netflix on October 15th, 2015.

The second season saw some changes to the voice cast. Matt Caplan (credited as Drew Aaron) took over the role of Lok Lambert from Yuri Lowenthal while Marc Diraison took over the role of Rassimov following the passing of Maddie Blaustein.

Plot

With the defeat of the Professor, a new menace has arrived. Rassimov has become stronger, and a new Organization has formed under Wilder. Having trained since their last battle with the Professor, Lok Lambert, Dante Vale, Sophie Casterwill, and Zhalia Moon must now face this new menace. To help with their adventures, a new Seeker, Den Fears, is recruited to face off against the Blood Spiral Brotherhood. In addition to this new member, the Powerbond has been unleashed, transforming the team's Titans to be stronger than ever before.

Having discovered Eathon Lambert's Holotome, the Huntik Foundation begins to investigate the Holotome's riddles concerning the prophecies of the ancient Seeker, Nostradamus. The truth about the Casterwill family becomes revealed bit by bit, beginning with the discovery of a legendary sword, the Willblade.

English Cast

• Sophie Casterwill - Rebecca Soler
• Dante Vale - Marc Thompson
• Zhalia Moon - Karen Strassman
• Cherit - Marc Thompson
• Den Fears - Grant George
• Rassimov - Marc Diraison
• Harrison Fears - Ben Diskin

Home Media

Unlike the first season, Season 2 was not physically released on DVD. In 2015, the series was made available on Netflix where it remained until 2020. In 2020, it was made available on childrens' streaming apps, HappyKids.tv and Kidoodle TV. In 2024, the entire season was made available on the official Huntik YouTube channel. In September 2026, the season began releasing on Amazon Prime as part Rainbow's Winx Club & Friends channel, beginning with the release of the first two episodes.

Trivia

• Several of this season's production errors are related to the new Powerbonding ability, with a common mistake being to show the original icons or amulets of Powerbonded Titans instead of the new ones.
• Two of Season 2's episodes are direct continuations of storylines from Season 1 :
• • The Legendary Titan of Fate is a follow-up to Crawling the Catacombs and Divide and Conquer
• • Lok's Leadership is a follow-up to The Vampire Loses Its Fangs
